name: borneol + brucea javanica fruit + camphor (natural) + cnidium monnieri fruit
uses: For the removal of common warts and plantar warts.
otcwarn: Do not use on moles, birthmarks, unusual warts with hair growing from them, or genital warts. Do not apply to broken skin or healthy skin surrounding the wart. May cause irritation. Discontinue use if severe discomfort or sensitivity occurs.

src.label: FAST-ACTING WART REMOVER
src.maker: Guangzhou Chuanglian Zhida Trading Co., Ltd
